say: Almost every song you know is built from just twelve notes.
show: Almost every song you know is built from just *twelve notes*.

say: Not hundreds. Not thousands. Just twelve. And in one minute, you will know them all.
show: Not hundreds. Not thousands. Just twelve. In one minute, you will *know them all*.
A  ·  B  ·  C  ·  D  ·  E  ·  F  ·  G

say: On a piano, these are the white keys. And after G, the alphabet simply starts again, at A.
show: On a piano, these are the *white keys*. After G, the alphabet *starts again* at A.

say: But between most of the white keys, there is one more note. The black key.
show: Between most of the white keys, there is *one more note*: the black key.

say: Just above C, it is C sharp. Just below D, it is D flat. One note, two names.
show: Just above C, it is *C♯*. Just below D, it is *D♭*. One note, two names.

say: Now look closely. B to C, and E to F. No black key, because there is no note between them.
show: B to C, and E to F: no black key, because there is *no note between them*.

say: So, let us count every note, starting from A.
show: So, let us count *every note*, starting from A.

say: Twelve notes. And the thirteenth? It is A again, just higher. That is called an octave.
show: The thirteenth note is A again, just higher. That is an *octave*.

say: On guitar, it is exactly the same. Every fret is one note. Twelve frets up, and you are back where you started.
show: On guitar, *every fret is one note*. Twelve frets up, and you are back where you started.

say: Most self taught players never learn this. You just did, in one minute.
show: Most self-taught players never learn this. *You just did.*

say: That was one complete Fret key lesson. Understand it. Hear it. See it on your instrument. Then, practise it.
show: One complete *Fretkey* lesson: understand it, hear it, see it on your instrument, practise it.

say: And there are more than two hundred and fifty of them, from your first note, all the way to jazz.
show: More than *250 lessons*, from your first note all the way to jazz.
